documents.summary: This invoice was issued by Sprout Social to Alexa Popplewell of the Santa Rosa Police Department for an annual premium plan subscription totaling $1,188.00. The invoice was billed on September 28, 2018, with payment due on receipt. Records confirm full payment of $1,188.00 via Visa on October 1, 2018, leaving a zero remaining balance.
